objective: Produce one combined acquisition performance snapshot for relationships created in an explicit created-at cohort using only economics and durable outcome evidence that occurred before one canonical upper-exclusive as-of cutoff.

semantics.presentation: current-state segmentation metadata; not historical reconstruction
semantics.effectiveAt: metadata only; never controls as-of inclusion

composition.cohort: exactly one canonical CRM listCreatedAtRange read
composition.attributedEconomics: canonical in-memory attributed economics application over current presentation plus filtered economics
composition.performanceProjection: reuse INS-004J canonical dimension validation and pure combined economics/outcome/cost projection

rules: Requested dimensions are validated and deduplicated before persistence access.
The created-at CRM query preserves caller date strings and omitted limit semantics.
The CRM created-at cohort is resolved exactly once.
Returned CRM relationship identities are canonically validated and deduplicated preserving first occurrence order.
INS-004L loads presentation, four raw economics fact families, and durable outcome facts exactly once for the canonical cohort.
INS-004K filters all economics and durable outcome facts exactly once using occurredAt < asOfExclusive.
Current presentation metadata remains unfiltered and may describe current state later than asOfExclusive.
Filtered economics are transformed to attributed relationship views entirely in memory.
The same filtered durable outcome facts are reused for outcome and acquisition-cost-per-outcome projections.
INS-004J remains the canonical owner of requested dimension normalization and combined per-dimension economics, outcome, and cost-per-outcome projection logic.
No second raw evidence load, outcome persistence read, or cutoff pass is permitted.

No new SQL, schema, persistence mutation, historical presentation reconstruction, alternate cutoff rule, arithmetic division, currency conversion, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: conversion within N days of relationship creation
